title: Quartic cyclic-Foulkes Betti bound for the binary Lemire interval
statement: For every n >= 401, put ell=ceil(n/2)-1 and let X_(n,ell,0) be Sawin's ordered-root complete intersection for the binary short interval with ell prescribed zero leading coefficients. For every squarefree divisor k of n, put F_(n,n/k)=Ind_(C_n)^(S_n) theta_(n/k). Then the total effective multiplicity B(F_(n,n/k))=sum_i dim((H_c^i(X_(n,ell,0),Q_l) tensor F_(n,n/k))^(S_n)) is at most n^4.
